newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND PLAN STREET PARTY FOR EUROPEAN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND PLAN STREET PARTY FOR EUROPEAN FINAL.

text.p: Thousands of Borussia Dortmund fans without tickets for Wednesday's European Cup final against Juventus in Munich will be able to watch the match on a giant screen in Dortmund city centre.
A spokesman for the city council said on Monday the screen would be set up in the central Friedensplatz square where Borussia celebrated their 1995 and 1996 Bundesliga titles.
"We expect between 30,000 and 40,000 people in the Friedensplatz and lots more in the surrounding area," he said.
The live transmission of the match will form the centrepiece of a programme of music and entertainment for the fans.
If they win the trophy, the city is also planning a motorcade and huge party to welcome back the team on Thursday -- a public holiday in Germany.
